questions.q: In March 2025, Operation Brahma was launched to assist earthquake hit __________.
questions.solution:
India launched Operation Brahma to provide relief after the March 2025 earthquake in Myanmar.

**Answer: Myanmar**

questions.q: Srinivasa Ramanujan, the mathematical genius, was passed away on April 26, 1920, at about what age?
questions.solution:
Ramanujan was born in December 1887 and died in April 1920, aged 32.

**Answer: 32**

questions.q: Who became the Chairman of ISRO in January 2025?
questions.solution:
V. Narayanan became ISRO Chairman in January 2025, succeeding S. Somanath.

**Answer: V. Narayanan**

questions.q: In Budget 2025, the Union Finance Minister announced to set up fifty thousand Atal Tinkering Labs in Government schools in next ________ years.
questions.solution:
The Budget 2025 announcement proposed 50000 Atal Tinkering Labs in government schools over the next five years.

**Answer: 5**

questions.q: SATAT initiative seen in news in November 2024 is related to which union ministry?
questions.solution:
SATAT, the Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation initiative, is under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.

**Answer: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas**

questions.q: In Cricket, a _____________ will be declared if the umpire thinks the batsman did not have a reasonable opportunity to score off the deliver.
questions.solution:
A delivery too far from the batter to play a normal cricket stroke may be called wide. The umpire assesses this under the wide-ball rule.

**Answer: Wide Ball**

questions.q: In Track and Field Events, 800 meters and 1500 meters are of which type of race?
questions.solution:
800 m and 1500 m are middle-distance track events. The grouped Middle/long option is the suitable listed category.

**Answer: Middle/long**

questions.q: In Cricket, a wide ball will add how many run/s to the batting team?
questions.solution:
A wide adds one penalty run to the batting team, apart from any additional runs scored.

**Answer: 1**

questions.q: Table tennis made its Olympic debut in ___________.
questions.solution:
Table tennis first appeared at the Olympic Games in Seoul in 1988.

**Answer: 1988**

questions.q: ICC Men's ODI Cricket World Cup 2027 will be held in which continent?

questions.q: Which traditional dance of Tamil Nadu is performed by women dancing in a circle while clapping their hands to a rhythm?
questions.solution:
Kummi is a Tamil folk dance in which women commonly dance in a circle and clap rhythmically.

**Answer: Kummi**

questions.q: Interest payment on debt incurred by the government is part of the _________.
questions.solution:
Interest payments are revenue expenditure. They do not create a new capital asset.

**Answer: Revenue expenditure**

questions.q: Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Limited established as a fully owned subsidiary of the Reserve bank in the year ___________.
questions.solution:
Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran was established as an RBI subsidiary in 1995.

**Answer: 1995**

questions.q: The Clearing Corporation of India Limited (CCIL) was established in ______________.
questions.solution:
The Clearing Corporation of India Limited was established in 2001.

**Answer: 2001**

questions.q: As per census 2001, what was the sex ratio of India?
questions.solution:
IndiaÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s 2001 census recorded 933 females per 1000 males.

**Answer: 933**

questions.q: In the context of economy, if __________ is deducted from the gross value added to obtain the Net value added obtained.
questions.solution:
Net value added equals gross value added minus depreciation, also called consumption of fixed capital.

**Answer: Depreciation**

questions.q: Where did Siddhartha Gautam meditate for many days?
questions.solution:
Siddhartha Gautama attained enlightenment after meditation at Bodh Gaya.

**Answer: Bodh Gaya**

questions.q: On the banks of which river was the Harappan site of 'Harappa' discovered in 1920-22?
questions.solution:
Harappa is situated on the banks of the Ravi River.

**Answer: Ravi**
